run_flux2klein_inpaint: run Flux2KleinInpaintPipeline to inpaint an image with a text prompt and mask
run_flux2klein_inpaint_ref: run Flux2KleinInpaintPipeline with image reference conditioning for inpainting
encode_prompt_flux2klein: encode text prompts into Qwen3 hidden state embeddings for Flux2 inpainting
prepare_latents_flux2klein: prepare denoising latents from input image with mask conditioning for Flux2 inpainting
patchify_latents_flux2: patchify image latents by folding 2x2 spatial patches into the channel dimension
